question: Select the MISSPELT spelt word.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is 'Emergensy'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us explore the meaning of the given options 
 
 
• Business - a person's regular occupation, profession, or trade. (व्यापार)
 
• Dreadful - causing or involving great suffering, fear, or unhappiness; extremely bad or serious. (भयानक)
 
• Emergensy - There is no such word in English or we can say that there is a spelling mistake in the word. 
 
• Inflammable - easily set on fire. (ज्वलनशील)
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• If we replace the letter s in the word emergensy with the letter c, we get the word emergency.
 
• Emergency is a proper English word and it means a serious, unexpected, and often dangerous situation requiring immediate action. (आपातकालीन)
